method: Direct native reevaluation of 1500 frozen matched HEFT endpoints, plus a same-path control disabling only the new Born-factor helper call.

repeat_roundoff.explanation: The older native Born cache already produces ulp-level roundoff when a point is repeatedly reevaluated through differing coupling references. First requests exactly retain archived values; no repeated-request bitwise guarantee is claimed.

reference_factor.expected: Native HEFT GHGG proportional to G^2 implies Born |ME|^2 proportional to alpha_s^2; native dynamic Born H_T/2=125/2=62.5 GeV, including H inverse Born. Separate LHAPDF hard factors and independent incoming-x projection.

limits: 321 transfer-capable contexts from 1500 frozen records. This validates effective coupling/reference scales and hard luminosity; it is not a fresh HEFT production or shower sample.
